_comment: PURCHASED KNOWLEDGE, TAUGHT BY NOTHING (owner, 2026-09-04). Every other blueprint in the
mod is learned by tearing down the object it came from; this one has no such object,
because there is no powder snow in this world to have found a bucket of. The Buy Terminal
is its only source, which is the first blueprint that is bought rather than earned.
Snowballs rather than snow blocks: powder snow is the LOOSE form, and a block is the
packed one. Snowballs are reachable here off a snow golem, which is the only reason this
recipe can be built at all once the sheet is bought.
